newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates edge up to end at 20.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates edge up to end at 20.50 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates rose a shade on Tuesday in a slow market, traders said.
Overnight rates traded between 20.375 and 20.75 percent and closed at 20.50 percent compared with Monday's close of 20.375 percent.
"Banks are cautiously probing the new market conditions," said Sandor Tolonics of Commerzbank.
The National Bank of Hungary on Friday cut its six-month deposit interest rate to 20.50 percent from 21.00 percent and the 12-month deposit interest rate to 20.25 percent from 20.50 percent.
